name: Friends With Unbelievers
overview: Scripture warns believers to be cautious in their associations with unbelievers, emphasizing that walking with the ungodly or fools can lead to spiritual harm and destruction, as seen in Psalms 1:1 and Proverbs 13:20. While friendship brings sweetness and mutual sharpening among wise companions (Proverbs 27:9, 27:17), believers are also instructed to avoid forming close bonds with those characterized by anger or fury (Proverbs 22:24). Matthew 7:6 further cautions against sharing sacred truths with those who will not value them, underscoring the need for discernment in relationships with unbelievers.
